The '''74th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievement in feature [[Film director|films]], [[Documentary film|documentary]], [[Television director|television]] and [[Television advertisement|commercials]] of 2021, were presented on March 12, 2022, at [[the Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chuba |first1=Kirsten |last2=Gajewski |first2=Ryan |last3=Lewis |first3=Hilary |title=DGA Awards: Jane Campion and 'The Power of the Dog' Take Top Honor |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/dga-awards-2022-winners-list-1235109846/ |access-date=March 13, 2022 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=March 12, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=74th Annual DGA Awards Winners |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2022/220312_74th_Annual_DGA_Awards_Winners.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=March 13, 2022 |date=March 12, 2022}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Judd Apatow]], who previously hosted the [[70th Directors Guild of America Awards|ceremonies in 2018]] and [[72nd Directors Guild of America Awards|2020]].<ref>{{cite web |title=74th Annual DGA Awards: Judd Apatow Returning as Host, Beth McCarthy-Miller to Chair |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2022/220210_DGAAnnouncesHostChairFor74ththAnnualDGAAwards.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=February 23, 2022 |date=February 10, 2022}}</ref> The nominations for the television and documentary categories were announced on January 26, 2022,<ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Television, Commercials and Documentary for 2021 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2022/220126_74thAnnualDGAAwardsTelevisionNomineesAnnounced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=January 26, 2022 |date=January 26, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Lewis |first1=Hilary |title=DGA Awards: 'Succession' Dominates Drama Series Nominees; 'Summer of Soul' and 'The Rescue' Up for Documentary Prize |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/dga-awards-2022-tv-commercial-documentary-nominations-nominees-list-1235081364/ |access-date=January 26, 2022 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 26, 2022}}</ref> while the nominations for the feature film categories were announced on January 27, 2022.<ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Theatrical Feature Film for 2021 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2022/2201279_74thAnnualDGAAwardsFeatureFilmNomineesAnnounced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=January 27, 2022 |date=January 27, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Davis |first1=Clayton |title=DGA Nominations: Jane Campion, Kenneth Branagh and Denis Villeneuve Lead the Directors Field |url=https://variety.com/2022/film/awards/dga-awards-nominations-2022-jane-campion-kenneth-branagh-denis-villeneuve-1235164705/ |access-date=January 27, 2022 |work=Variety |date=January 27, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Hammond |first1=Pete |last2=Hipes |first2=Patrick |title=DGA Awards Set 2022 Date & Timeline, Reinstate Theatrical First-Run Rule For Best Picture – Update |url=https://deadline.com/2021/08/dga-awards-2022-date-eligibility-rules-1234783496/ |website=Deadline |access-date=January 8, 2022 |date=August 18, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces 2022 Awards Schedule |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2021/210818_74th_DGA_Awards_Schedule.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=January 8, 2022 |date=August 18, 2021}}</ref>
